roles: Root assigned advisory completeness inspection. Publication agent authors adapter/proof/controls. Reviewer authors no executable or new enumeration and supplies scope findings only.

findings.detail: Search REQUIRE_2T=false replaces local2T maximal inclusions by all maximal inclusions. RankTwoAdmissible already tests every B-double coset in Q. E4, typed Helly, RWPRI and normalizer augmentation do not require 2T. The printed panel-set theorem must state this broader family explicitly.

Complete representatives for every G-conjugacy class of subgroups, plus complete maximal-subgroup conjugacy classes inside every representative. The rank-two catalogue does not supply this premise. Include actual transporter/normalizer exact algorithms, all trivial/full representatives, and the retained named group identity.

Input probe L3(4) gives95 classes in a literal21-point model different from the accepted PSL34 model. The saved generator-image isomorphism is validated bijective. Freeze and reuse that same literal map for all inputs, restarted anchors, fusion and verification. Legacy fusion/verification reconstruct the original TomLib model, so cannot be blindly used on transported checkpoints.

Cover all95 anchors from the retained table, including no-panel B=G. Inner/type equivalence is within each fixed B via N_G(B). Full Aut fusion must permit different Borel IDs to fuse; do not filter anchors by source Borel orders, source totals, rank-two outcomes or observed2T.

Every adjoining panel strictly enlarges the join by E4. Omega([G:B]) bounds rank; the code tries one additional level and refuses nonempty final level. Require each actual terminal done/checkpoint/source/input/receipt binding; a cap, interrupted prefix, partial checkpoint or matching expected count is not exhaustion.
phase7_sporadic_finish.py has --require-2t store_true defaultTrue, hence no false CLI path. It is suitable for its historical locally2T application, not a broad L100 entrypoint.

phase7_sporadic_verify.g unconditionally conjoins r.twot. The underlying VerifyGeometry computes all general exact tests and reports twot separately; broad acceptance must omit only the twot requirement while preserving firm/ft/rc/rwpri/ip2/join/borel/panel reconstruction.

phase7_sporadic_fuse.g general Aut/type equivalence is reusable, but truncation processing skips non2T lower and higher witnesses. L100 broad truncation clauses cannot be inferred from that historical restricted pass.

An exhaustive marked enumeration and exact full Aut(G)/type fusion classify group-marked coset families. Source physical7 separately claims abstract geometries up to isomorphism, G-conjugacy fusion multiplicities, and full type-preserving Aut/Cor groups. Abstract nonisomorphism or full incidence automorphism orders require exact additional invariants/isomorphism computation or a proved characteristic-action argument.

algorithm_read.IsMaxPair: Order lookup is a necessary prefilter only, followed by actual maximality/primitive-action tests under subgroup inclusion.
algorithm_read.augmentation_join: Because prior join H is maximal in chosen K and new panel is outside H, their actual join is K; choosing First containing overgroup does not replace an unverified join.
algorithm_read.orbits: Pointwise stabilizer of ordered prior panels preserves allowed extensions; smaller than setwise stabilizer only creates duplicates.
algorithm_read.IP2: B-double cosets in Q classify stabilizer orbits of P-type neighbours of base Q. Any two tested distinct neighbours already share Q; outside a digon their common-neighbour count must equal one.
algorithm_read.Helly: Exact candidate coset sets contain the common-intersection group orbit; equality of counts is equality of finite sets. All subfamilies are checked.

future_controls_recommended: Preserve positive non2T examples and a genuine rank3 example in complete tiny all-family controls.
Reject missing/duplicate Borel terminal records and a nonempty final level without launching a group census.
Check exact transported subgroup membership/order/inclusion and fixed generator-image map; reject mixed-model checkpoints.
Test Aut fusion across distinct inner Borel classes where an outer automorphism fuses them, and retain literal automorphism/type witnesses.
Do not impose published rank/count/Borel/2T targets as search or acceptance filters.
